Title: Frequently asked questions
Subtitle: What to know about our role, our independence and how we work.
Answer1: A family office is a structure dedicated to organising a family's wealth: consolidating assets, coordinating banks and advisors, governance and succession. It acts as the family's single point of contact, over the long term.
Question2: What is the difference between a single family office and a multi family office?
Answer2: A single family office serves one family, with a dedicated team whose full cost the family bears. A multi-family office such as Ridger shares infrastructure, tools and expertise across several families, with a comparable standard of care at a fraction of the cost.
Answer3: No. Execution, custody and asset management remain with your regulated banks and managers. Ridger consolidates, oversees, coordinates and reports — independently, with no conflict of interest with those who manage.
Question4: From what level of wealth does a family office make sense?
Answer4: Complexity matters more than any threshold: several banking relationships, real estate, holding structures, an international dimension or a succession to prepare. These situations warrant consolidated oversight, typically from a few million francs.
Question5: Do you work with our existing advisors?
Answer5: Yes. Ridger orchestrates your existing ecosystem — bankers, lawyers, notaries, tax advisors, insurers — without replacing it. We prepare files, follow up on decisions and keep the whole coherent.
Answer6: Exclusively through fees agreed with the family, defined at the initial consultation according to the scope entrusted. Ridger receives no retrocessions or commissions from banks or managers.
Answer7: In Switzerland. Family documents and data reside on Swiss infrastructure, encrypted, with controlled named access. Discretion and professional secrecy structure every process.
Question8: What does a first consultation look like?
Answer8: A confidential, no-obligation conversation, in Geneva or remotely, to understand your situation and priorities. We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
Answer9: Yes. Ridger belongs to no bank and distributes no financial products. This independence guarantees that our reading of your statements, performance and fees serves one interest only: yours.
Answer10: Ridger is a brand of the Ark group, operated by Ark Fiduciaire SA in Geneva, affiliated with the SRO SO-FIT. Families benefit from an established Swiss framework with a resolutely digital approach.
